|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on your AT-AT that does not have a maint-enance cost. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Add 1 if targeting a character, 2 if a vehicle. Target hit if total destiny > defense value. When this weapon lost from table, place it in your Used Pile.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[AT-AT Cannon (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on your non-[Maintenance] AT-AT. May target a character or vehicle at same or adjacent site for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +1 (+2 if a vehicle) > defense value. If just lost from table, place this weapon in Used Pile.” '''What changed:''' “AT-AT that does not have a maint-enance cost.” → “non-[Maintenance] AT-AT.”; removed “Add 1 if targeting a character, 2 if a vehicle.”; removed “total”; added “+1 (+2 if a vehicle)”; “When this weapon” → “If just”; “it” → “this weapon”; removed “your”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 27.
